entities.name: Gerardus Mercator
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Flemish cartographer (1512-1594) who created the Mercator projection (1569), a cylindrical map projection that represents lines of constant course as straight lines — essential for maritime navigation. His world maps and atlases (a term he popularized) defined modern cartography and remained standard for navigation for over 400 years.
